**Finding submitted: IP — missing (fallback cure proposed).**

- **What the document does:** There is no IP/data article at all. "Deliverables" appear only inside Kubient's warranties (p0033; p0040 states Kubient is "the rightful owner or licensee of all intellectual property rights to the Service, the Auction Platform and products delivered hereunder"), and the only grant to AP (p0002) is "limited... non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable" and is expressly revoked on termination (p0021). Nothing addresses AP's Content/Requests data beyond risk allocation (p0025, p0043–p0045).
- **Why it fails fallback:** no perpetual/irrevocable/worldwide/royalty-free licence to use, modify or sublicense deliverables, and no limitation on Kubient's use of AP data.
- **Cure:** one inserted paragraph 6(b) — Kubient keeps its generic tools, know-how and the Auction Platform; AP receives the perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables (Auction Platform carved out so paragraph 4(c) is not contradicted); any Kubient licence in AP data is limited to processing solely to provide the Services. All eight fallback elements are carried by that single operation.
